Question: How do I complete re-verification if I'm asked to update my KYC?

Answer: Visit a NovaTel Experience Store with original ID proof, or complete Video KYC via the app under Account > KYC Update if enabled in your circle. Failure to complete requested re-verification within the notified window may result in service suspension per licence conditions.

Topic: KYC & Identity Verification
title: How do I complete re-verification if I'm asked to update my KYC?
